boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's os_alloc.c, 0x02059040..0x020593a8: 6 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/OS_alloc.c defines, in this order, DLAddFront, DLExtract, DLInsert, OS_AllocFromHeap and OS_FreeToHeap; all five are here, body for body. pret leaves out OS_InitAlloc, which comes after them in the SDK's file: 0x02059040 is it by body (OSiHeapInfo[id] = arenaStart, maxHeaps heap descriptors of size -1, currentHeap -1, the 32-aligned memory after them returned).

Order: mwccarm emits deferred bodies in reverse. The ROM run is the source order reversed, OS_InitAlloc lowest and DLAddFront highest. The SDK's other heap functions are not called and were dropped by the linker.
TOP EDGE: CP15::EnableDTCM (0x020593a8) opens the next run.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/OS_Tick and arm9/OS_Alarm: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
The SDK names were given in this change (symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence).
